newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Proton aims to build on exports.
newsitem.headline: Proton aims to build on exports.

text.p: Malaysia's national auto maker Perusahaan Otomobil Nasional Bhd (Proton) rolled out its one-millionth car and a new model on Monday and said its target was to build up exports.

"It has taken us 11 years to produce this one-millionth car but we are set to manufacture the next one million units in less than four years," Proton chairman Yahaya Ahmad said at the launching ceremony.
Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad unveiled the sixth and newest Proton model at the ceremony. The 1.8-litre Putra is priced at around 69,000 ringgit ($27,400).
Proton is currently exporting to 39 countries, but its current production capacity is only 180,000 cars a year.
Yahaya said Proton's ultimate goal was a million cars a year but there was no immediate timeframe.
"Our mission is to be a world-class automotive producer, a major export earner for the country and a leading Malaysian high-technology employer," he said.
